description: Defines the Artifact class for managing artifacts in Playwright, including saving, deleting, and error handling.

classes.name: Artifact
classes.description: Represents an artifact with methods for saving, deleting, and error reporting.

methods.name: finishedPromise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the artifact is finished.

methods.name: localPath
methods.description: Returns the local file path of the artifact.

methods.name: localPathAfterFinished
methods.description: Returns the local path after ensuring the artifact has finished, throws if inaccessible or failed.

methods.name: saveAs
methods.description: Registers a callback to save the artifact.

methods.name: failureError
methods.description: Returns the failure error message if any.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the artifact operation via the cancel callback.

methods.name: deleteOnContextClose
methods.description: Deletes the artifact when the context closes, without waiting for finish.

methods.name: reportFinished
methods.description: Marks the artifact as finished, resolving callbacks and promise.
